step1_analysis.circuit_type: Continuous-Time FIR Filter Delay Cell / Equalizer
step1_analysis.description: A differential delay cell with diode-connected PMOS loads and active source degeneration. The source degeneration transistors (XM5, XM6) introduce a zero for high-frequency peaking, acting as an equalizer to compensate for channel attenuation.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS 0.25-m Continuous-Time FIR Filter With 125 ps per Tap Delay as a Fractionally Spaced Receiver Equalizer for 1-Gb/s Data Transmission

sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's tuning range of 100ps to 300ps. Depends heavily on the load capacitance.
Expected to be around 2-3 GHz to support 1-Gb/s data transmission without severe inter-symbol interference.

power.description: DC power consumption of the delay cell

sky130_expected.reasoning: The 45mW reported in the paper is for the entire 6-tap filter (multiple cells + adders). A single cell consumes a fraction of that.
Delay cells typically have near unity gain (0-5 dB) to prevent signal saturation or severe attenuation across multiple cascaded taps.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure group delay, bandwidth, gain, and power of the FIR filter delay cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for FIR Filter Delay Cell
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

* DUT
XM4 OUTn INp N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 OUTp INn N2 N2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 OUTn OUTn VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 OUTp OUTp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5 N2 INp N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 INn N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VINp INp 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 100MEG 0 0)
VINn INn 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.1 100MEG 0 0)

* Tail currents (required for differential pair operation, added to complete the circuit)
I1 N1 0 100u
I2 N2 0 100u

* Load capacitance (simulating next stage input capacitance)
C1 OUTp 0 20f
C2 OUTn 0 20f

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(OUTp) v(OUTn) v(N1) v(N2)

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1MEG 10G
  let vout_diff = v(OUTp) - v(OUTn)
  let vin_diff = v(INp) - v(INn)
  let gain_mag = mag(vout_diff / vin_diff)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
  
  let phase_rad = cph(vout_diff) - cph(vin_diff)
  let group_delay = - deriv(phase_rad) / (2 * PI)
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1MEG
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  meas ac unity_gain_freq when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac delay_100M find group_delay at=100MEG
  
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 20n
  meas tran vout_max max v(OUTp)
  meas tran vout_min min v(OUTp)
  
  quit
.endc
